issues.description: The problem text instructs students to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public for easier testing, but the UML in the problem statement shows this method as private and both the template and solution declare it as private. This contradiction (UML vs. prose) and the template/solution visibility (private) conflict with the prose requirement and could confuse students or cause tests that expect a public helper to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the visibility mismatch by choosing one consistent specification. Either: (A) Make singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) public in the template and solution (change its declaration to public) to match the prose guidance and tests that expect a public helper; or (B) Update the problem text and UML to state the method is private if it should remain an internal helper. Ensure all artifacts (UML, prose, template, solution, and tests) use the same visibility.
